annotation.title_clean: 苏州市低空经济促进条例
annotation.title_en: Suzhou Municipal Regulations on Promoting the Low-Altitude Economy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 苏州市人民代表大会常务委员会 (Suzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee); approved by Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee
annotation.summary_en: Suzhou municipal regulation, adopted June 2025 and approved by Jiangsu in July, effective 1 October 2025. It promotes the low-altitude economy (drones, eVTOL) through industry support, infrastructure, flight services, application scenarios, incentives and safety rules, including mandatory liability insurance, a safety guarantee fund, data security and counter-drone restrictions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes government duties and department responsibilities for promoting the low-altitude economy, with planning, funding and talent support
Mandates building low-altitude infrastructure, a smart networked system and a unified flight service platform
Requires liability insurance for flight operators and supports a low-altitude safety guarantee fund for advance compensation
Imposes data security and personal information protection duties on low-altitude flight activities
Bans unlawful possession or use of counter-drone equipment; police may take emergency measures against illegal drone flights; effective 1 Oct 2025
